title: TOGAF
lead: The Open Group Architecture Framework — the most widely adopted enterprise architecture methodology for designing, planning and governing IT architecture.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: TOGAF provides a comprehensive approach and set of tools for developing enterprise architecture. At its core is the Architecture Development Method (ADM) — a cycle of phases that guides architects from strategy through to implementation and governance. TOGAF covers four architecture domains: Business, Data, Application and Technology (BDAT).

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: TOGAF is used in ITOM engagements to structure the enterprise architecture analysis that underpins operating model design. The architecture domains map directly to ITOM dimensions: business processes, data governance, application landscape and technology platform.
